AT+CIPCLOSE Close TCP or UDP Connection: Write Command 1) If single IP connection (+CIPMUX=0)
column2: Response: 1) For single IP connection (+CIPMUX=0) CLOSE OK 2) For multi IP connection (+CIPMUX=1) <n>, CLOSE OK
Parameters <n> 0 Slow close 1 Quick close <id> A numeric parameter which indicates the connection number
